title: Baccha Shoshur
desc: Spandan leads a blissful married life with his wife, Jonaki. However, things take a hilarious turn after their son, Gutlu, is born.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Amar Shapath
desc: A young boy's parents are killed by a dangerous criminal who also kidnaps his sister. Several years later, he plans to find his sister and avenge his parents' death by murdering the culprit.

title: Anjali
desc: A devout father arranges his daughter's marriage with a renowned businessman. However, the daughter secretly resents the union as she is madly in love with her boyfriend.

title: Sukh Dukher Sansar
desc: Amar, the eldest of four, struggles to provide a better life to his younger siblings. However, things take a turn for the worse when his younger sister meets with an accident and is visually impaired.

title: Satru Mitra
desc: A happy family goes through various trials and tribulations and falls apart when greed takes precedence over relationships.

title: Loafer
desc: Bikram is a selfless man who is unfairly hated by his family. However, after an arrest for helping a friend marry, he struggles to gain the respect of those he constantly protects.
